questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: A full-screen photo with tags 'Imperfection' and 'Signs of wear' and a thumbnail strip reads as a defect-tagged photo viewer.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The photo with its tags fills the screen, and the thumbnails switch photos.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The 'X' and thumbnails are clear, but the eye icon at bottom right doesn't say it toggles the tags.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Imperfection' and 'Signs of wear' are plain words.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked of the buyer.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Tags can be hidden via the eye icon, but four overlapping 'Imperfection' tags crowd the top of the photo by default and don't say what each flaw is.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Photo inspection with defect tags fits a buyer evaluating condition.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Only short tag labels appear over the image.
